## task_010: Downstream Candidate -- Run Club Scheduling Boundary

Draft a short text to Marcus Johnson saying I may miss part of run club because of Riverside Family Practice. Keep it casual and do not pretend the exact timing is settled if the prompt does not establish it.
answer:

See you when I see you!
Alice
---
